task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the CAMEO Chemicals website in a browser.
Agent searches for and views the chemical reports for Methane, Propane, Hydrogen, and Acetone.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the search results or individual chemical data pages on the CAMEO website.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies the correct LEL (%) values from the NIOSH section of the chemical reports.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent highlighting or scrolling to the 'NIOSH Pocket Guide' or 'Explosive Limits' section on the website.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a text file at the specified path /home/ga/Documents/alarm_setpoints.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the file path /home/ga/Documents/alarm_setpoints.txt.

task_completion.description: The report contains the correct chemical names, LEL percentages, and calculated setpoints in ppm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final content of the file showing: Methane | 5.0 | 5000; Propane | 2.1 | 2100; Hydrogen | 4.0 | 4000; Acetone | 2.5 or 2.6 | 2500 or 2600.

integrity.description: Agent actually browsed the CAMEO site rather than guessing values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Browser history or sequential screenshots showing the search and retrieval process on the NOAA website.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply echo the final values without visiting the source.
integrity.visual_evidence: Absence of the final report content appearing in the terminal before the browser was opened.

integrity.description: Agent performed the math (10% of LEL * 10,000) rather than copying a pre-made table.
integrity.visual_evidence: Calculations visible in terminal, scratchpad, or logical progression in the report creation.

privileged_info_for_vlm: Verified LEL values from CAMEO/NIOSH: Methane = 5.0% (Setpoint: 5000 ppm); Propane = 2.1% (Setpoint: 2100 ppm); Hydrogen = 4.0% (Setpoint: 4000 ppm); Acetone = 2.5% or 2.6% (Setpoint: 2500 or 2600 ppm). Note: Acetone has a known discrepancy between 2.5% and 2.6% in NIOSH/CAMEO sources; either is acceptable if it matches the source viewed. Conversion formula: (LEL % * 0.10) * 10,000.
